s: strI, budDyutTitakaRWagatanAdarUpavarRaH । yaTA, -- “mUlADArAt praTamamudito yastu tAraH parAKyaH । paScAt paSyantyaTa hfdayago budDiyuNmaDyamAKyaH । vaktre vEKaryyaTa rurudizorasya jantoH suzumnAbadDastasmAdBavati pavanaprerito varRasaMvaH ॥” ityalaNkArakOstuBaH ॥ asyArTaH । yastu tAro nAdaH varRarUpaH sa nABirUpamUlADArAt praTamamudayaprAptaScet para iti AsyA saMjYA yasya taTABUto Bavati । aTAnantaraM sa eva hfdayaM cittaM gataScet rodanasamaye nAsikAdbArA yaTAkaTaYcit Bavati । rurudizorjantornAsAmaDyasTitasuzumnAnAqyA badDaH । taTA ca nAsAdvArEva yaTAkaTaYcit nAdasvarUpaH pratyakzamBavatItyarTaH । tasmAt vEKarIdaSApannAt nAdAt pavanaprerito varRasamUho bahiH sarvvezAM pratyakzavizayo BavatItyarTaH । parA paSyantI daSApannasya tu yoginAmeva pratyakze na tu sarvvezAmityapi boDyam । iti tawwIkA ॥

m: वैखरी f. N. of a partic. sound, RāmatUp.; Pat.

speech in the fourth of its four stages from the first stirring of the air or breath, articulate utterance, that utterance of sounds or words which is complete as consisting of full and intelligible sentences, MW.
the faculty of speech or the divinity presiding over it, ib.
speech in general, A.
a: वैखरी — 1 Articulate utterance, production of sound; see Malli. on Ku. 2. 17. --2 The faculty of speech. --3 Speech in general.
